name: Risk Register
description: Risk register workbook: structured per-risk table on its own sheet (human-filled today) + a Cover summary. Engine fills cover metadata; AI writes a single risk-overview narrative on the Cover so reviewers see curated prose, not raw bullets.

sections.title: Risk overview
sections.purpose:
Narrative summary of the engagement's risk surface, in two short parts:

1. **Summary** (3–5 sentences). How many risks were identified, severity distribution at a high level, the two or three biggest concerns and why they matter.

2. **Cross-cutting themes** (markdown bullets, 3–5 items). Patterns that span multiple risks — e.g. 'identity and access', 'multi-region resilience', 'third-party dependencies'. For each theme one short sentence, no category prefixes.

No `[severity/category]` style prefixes anywhere. This narrative replaces the previous raw risks bullet-list that dumped every risk verbatim.
